# Lemon

> Lemon is a local-first, BEAM-native AI agent runtime with durable sessions, memory, skills, supervised tools, automation, channels, and deterministic simulation.

- [Complete machine-readable documentation](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/llms-full.txt)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/z80dev/lemon)

## Start here

- [Index](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/): Product overview and paths into the documentation.
- [Lemon quickstart](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/getting-started/quickstart): Install, verify a provider-backed chat, resume the session, choose a next feature, and recover from failures.
- [Install Lemon](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/install): Release installer, source install, first-run setup, and supported platforms.
- [Demo Lemon](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/demo): A deterministic local walkthrough for the runtime and interfaces.
- [Set up Lemon](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/user-guide/setup): Configure providers, secrets, runtime settings, and channels.
- [User-managed profiles](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/user-guide/profiles): Create, route, clone, export, and delete isolated specialist profiles.
- [Support](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/support): Diagnose startup, provider, runtime, and release problems.
- [Compare Lemon](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/compare): Current product positioning and honest support boundaries.

## Use Lemon

- [Memory User Guide](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/user-guide/memory): Durable local memory and recall behavior.
- [Skills User Guide](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/user-guide/skills): Discover, install, audit, and use skills.
- [Adaptive Behavior User Guide](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/user-guide/adaptive): Opt-in learning, synthesis, and rollout controls.
- [Honcho Memory User Guide](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/user-guide/honcho): Configure the optional Honcho memory provider.
- [Migrating From Hermes](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/user-guide/migrate-from-hermes): Preview and import supported Hermes state.
- [Lemon Configuration (TOML)](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/config): Runtime configuration and environment-variable ownership.
- [Mix task reference](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/mix-tasks): Reference for Lemon Mix tasks.

## Tools and interfaces

- [Web and Browser Tools](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/tools/web): Web search, fetch, and browser automation tools.
- [Execute Code (executecode)](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/tools/execute-code): Persistent Python RPC execution over allowlisted agent tools.
- [Media Tools](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/tools/media): Media generation and artifact workflows.
- [LSP Diagnostics](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/tools/lsp): Language-server diagnostics.
- [ACP Preview](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/tools/acp): ACP-shaped editor integration.
- [OpenAI-Compatible API Preview](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/tools/openai-compatible-api): OpenAI-compatible API surface.
- [Extensions](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/extensions): MCP, native, and WASM extension boundaries.
- [LemonSkills - Skill Definitions and Loading](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/skills): Skill format, discovery, trust, and lifecycle reference.

## Architecture and operations

- [Architecture Overview](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/architecture/overview): System architecture and message flow.
- [BEAM Agent Architecture and Invariants](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/beam_agents): BEAM-native agent processes, supervision, and coordination.
- [LemonAgent.Context - Conversation Context Management](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/context): Context assembly, compaction, and overflow behavior.
- [Decoupling Model Selection from Profile Binding](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/model-selection-decoupling): Provider and model selection design.
- [Lemon Safety](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/security/safety): Approval, redaction, and execution safety boundaries.
- [Lemon testing lanes](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/testing): Canonical test lanes and focused verification guidance.
- [Telemetry](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/telemetry): Runtime telemetry and observability events.
- [Versioning and Release Channels](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/release/versioning_and_channels): CalVer releases and update channels.

## Benchmarks and parity

- [Benchmarks Quickstart](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/benchmarks/quickstart): Run a LemonSim benchmark locally.
- [Benchmark Platform Guarantees](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/benchmarks/platform): Determinism, replay, and benchmark guarantees.
- [Lemon ↔ Hermes Functionality and UX Gap Audit](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/plans/lemon-hermes-gap-audit-2026-08-11): Current pinned non-transport Hermes comparison and implementation backlog.
- [Lemon ↔ Hermes-Class Agent Harness Parity Scorecard](https://z80dev.github.io/lemon/plans/lemon-hermes-agent-harness-parity-scorecard): Detailed Lemon harness implementation ledger.

## Notes for agents

- Treat historical matrices and plans as dated evidence; the current Hermes gap audit identifies its exact upstream and Lemon revisions.
- Public documentation describes supported behavior. Source modules and tests remain authoritative for implementation details.
